ABI helpers for transaction layout, address lookup resolution, and transaction initialization.

# Purpose
This header defines the ABI layer used to build a `RuntimeTransaction<SanitizedTransaction>` view for bank processing. It declares the fixed transaction size, the sidecar layout for variable-length data, and the error codes used during transaction initialization and address lookup table resolution. The file also declares [`fd_bank_abi_resolve_address_lookup_tables`](<#fd_bank_abi_resolve_address_lookup_tables>), [`fd_bank_abi_txn_init`](<#fd_bank_abi_txn_init>), and [`fd_bank_abi_get_lookup_addresses`](<#fd_bank_abi_get_lookup_addresses>), which prepare transaction data and expose the expanded lookup addresses to later code. The `fd_bank_abi_txn_t` type is an opaque handle for a memory layout that matches the Rust runtime transaction interface without owning the underlying vector storage.
